questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how these tests verify the service's behavior? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
StreamSessionService takes a Clock and a Supplier<String> for ids instead of calling Instant.now() and UUID.randomUUID() directly. What does that make possible in the tests?
choices: Running the tests in parallel without any shared state.
Asserting exact timestamps and ids, and placing sessions precisely inside or outside the heartbeat window.
Avoiding Mockito, because the clock replaces the stores.
Making the heartbeat timeout configurable per test.

questions.prompt: Suppose start() were changed to count all of the user's sessions against the plan limit before filtering out stale heartbeats. Which existing test would fail?

choices: start() no longer refreshes the heartbeat of the session it resumes.
start() moves the resume check after the plan limit check.
start() inserts a duplicate row while also returning the existing session.
start() returns a new session with the same field values instead of the existing object.
